# Hierarchical Ecoregion Stratification (`ecoregions.R`) {#ecoregions}

```{r ch5-setup, include = FALSE}
source('R/00_setup.R')
```

Specific optical properties of dissolved organic matter (e.g., aromaticity and specific UV absorbance; Spencer et al. 2012; Griffin et al. 2018) and suspended particles (e.g., mineral grain size, refractive index, and organic coatings; Dodds & Whiles 2004; Bowers et al. 2020) vary systematically with regional geology, soils, vegetation, and climate. To capture this regional biogeochemical coherence across streams, lakes, and estuaries within a unified continental classification, each monitoring station is assigned to its nested U.S. EPA / CEC North American Ecoregion across **Levels I–IV** (Omernik & Griffith 2014).

The spatial assignment function (`eco_join()` in `R/ecoregions.R`) places each unique `SiteID` into the projected ecoregion polygon containing its geographic coordinates; estuarine and nearshore stations located slightly offshore of the vector coastline are matched to the nearest terrestrial ecoregion polygon via `sf::st_nearest_feature()`, and polygon-boundary ties are deduplicated (`distinct(SiteID, .keep_all = TRUE)`) so the mapping from `SiteID` to ecoregion is strictly **1-to-1**.

```{r eco-map, fig.height = 4.4}
eco <- get_eco()
eco$eco3 %>% group_by(l3code) %>% summarize() %>% st_simplify(dTolerance = 5000) %>%
  ggplot() + geom_sf(aes(fill = l3code), colour = 'white', linewidth = 0.1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = 'turbo') + theme_void() + ggtitle('U.S. EPA Level III Ecoregions (NA_L3CODE)')
```

## Minimum Group Sample-Size Criterion (`zone_min = 100`)

Across all regional models, an ecoregion (or ecoregion $\times$ water-body type combination) is estimated as an independent parameter group if and only if it contains more than **`r P$zone_min` training observations** (`P$zone_min = 100`). Observations located in sparsely sampled ecoregions ($\le 100$ training records) fall back to the corresponding continental model (Model 1 for type-agnostic models; Model 2 for type-stratified models) during model evaluation and ternary projection.

```{r zone-counts}
zc <- cache_rds('zone_counts', zone_counts(get_training(), eco))
zc %>% group_by(level) %>%
  summarize(`Ecoregions with Training Data` = n(),
            `Modeled Ecoregions (> 100 obs)` = sum(n > P$zone_min),
            `Training Observations in Modeled Ecoregions` = fmt_n(sum(n[n > P$zone_min])),
            `Dataset Coverage (%)` = round(100 * sum(n[n > P$zone_min]) / nrow(get_training()), 2)) %>%
  kable(col.names = c('Ecoregion Hierarchy', 'Total Ecoregions Present', 'Modeled Ecoregions (> 100 obs)', 'Training Rows Covered', 'Coverage (%)')) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c('condensed', 'striped'), full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r zone-sets}
zs <- get_zone_sets()
tibble(dataset = c('Continental (USA)', 'EPA Level I', 'EPA Level II', 'EPA Level III', 'EPA Level IV'),
       key = names(zs),
       rows = map_int(zs, nrow),
       groups = map_int(zs, ~ if ('code' %in% names(.x)) n_distinct(.x$code) else 1L)) %>%
  mutate(rows = fmt_n(rows)) %>%
  kable(col.names = c('Spatial Hierarchy', 'Dataset Key', 'Training Observations (> 100 per group)', 'Modeled Ecoregions')) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c('condensed', 'striped'), full_width = FALSE)
```

::: {.decision}
**Methodological Decisions: Ecoregion Stratification (`R/ecoregions.R`)**

* **Point-level ecoregion assignment unifies streams, lakes, and estuaries.** Because standardized upstream watershed polygons are neither defined nor physically meaningful for the `63,566` estuarine training observations (`77,637` total estuarine records) and because Omernik ecoregions explicitly integrate regional physiography, geology, soils, and land cover (Omernik & Griffith 2014), point-in-polygon assignment evaluates all three water-body types within a single consistent hierarchy.
* **Comprehensive Level III coverage.** Under the $> 100$ observation threshold, **46 Level III ecoregions** receive dedicated bio-optical parameters in Model 7, encompassing **99.69%** (`r fmt_n(nrow(zs$L3))` of `r fmt_n(nrow(get_training()))`) of all continental training observations.
:::
